remarks: Welcome to 3194 Dutch Hollow Rd in Bemus Point! This well-maintained 3-bedroom, 2-bath ranch offers comfortable one-floor living with an open floor plan and plenty of space inside and out. A large front entry welcomes you into the home and leads to the main living areas. The kitchen features stainless steel appliances and flows easily into the dining and living spaces. The primary bedroom includes a private full bath with convenient laundry, while two additional bedrooms and a second full bath complete the main level. Recent improvements include a forced-air furnace, central air conditioning, a newer septic system new hot water tank, and carpeting in the bedrooms. A spacious unfinished basement provides excellent storage, additional laundry hookups and plenty of potential for future use. Outside, enjoy a large fenced yard, back deck and attached two-car garage. Located in the Bemus Point School District, this move-in-ready ranch offers a great combination of space, updates and convenient single-level living.
